name: tcc-safe-travel-assessment

scripts.test:firebase: npm run firebase:build && node --test tests/rubric-integrity.test.mjs tests/firebase-config.test.mjs tests/school-directory.test.mjs && node --test --experimental-strip-types tests/scoring.test.ts tests/dashboard-export.test.ts tests/benchmarking.test.ts tests/access-roles.test.ts
scripts.firebase:build: npm run schools:assets && vite --config vite.firebase.config.ts build
scripts.firebase:serve: npm run firebase:build && firebase emulators:start --only hosting,firestore
scripts.firebase:deploy: node scripts/validate-firebase-env.mjs && npm run firebase:build && firebase deploy --only hosting,firestore:rules,firestore:indexes
scripts.firebase:release: npm run lint && npm run test:firebase && npm run firebase:deploy && npm run firebase:smoke
